text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I thought I saw something, but it<n>couldn't possibly
have been real...<n>What's this feeling?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm bursting with energy! I feel fully<n>capable of
bringing my new theories<n>to fruition!
